productions.title: Clash of the Titans
productions.summary: Ray Harryhausen's stop-motion epic follows Perseus as he faces the Kraken and challenges the gods of Olympus.

productions.title: Big Trouble in Little China
productions.summary: A cult action-fantasy steeped in Chinese mythic imagery, sorcery, and the storm powers of Lo Pan's court.

productions.title: Ramayana: The Legend of Prince Rama
productions.studio: Nippon Ramayana Film Co. / Pentamedia Graphics
productions.summary: An Indo-Japanese animated retelling of the Sanskrit epic, following Rama's exile, Sita's abduction, and the war with Ravana.

productions.title: Hercules
productions.summary: Disney's animated musical recasts Herakles as a hero who must reclaim his godhood and rescue Mount Olympus from Hades.

productions.title: Princess Mononoke
productions.summary: Miyazaki's film draws on Shinto and Japanese folk kami in its conflict between forest spirits and an industrializing human settlement.

productions.title: Stargate SG-1
productions.summary: The long-running military-science-fiction series recasts Egyptian gods as parasitic Goa'uld who once posed as divine pharaohs.

productions.title: Mulan
productions.summary: Disney's animated adaptation of the Chinese ballad emphasizes ancestor veneration and dragon iconography.

productions.title: The Mummy
productions.summary: A swashbuckling horror-adventure revolving around Imhotep's curse, with heavy Egyptian funerary and deity imagery.

productions.title: O Brother, Where Art Thou?
productions.summary: The Coen brothers' Depression-era comedy loosely adapts the Odyssey, with Everett standing in for Odysseus and Penny for Penelope.

productions.title: The Road to El Dorado
productions.summary: Two con artists are mistaken for gods in a Mesoamerican-inspired city of gold, borrowing Aztec and Maya visual motifs.

productions.title: Spirited Away
productions.summary: A girl enters a bathhouse for spirits populated by kami, yokai, and figures rooted in Japanese folk and Buddhist lore.

productions.title: Naruto
productions.summary: The ninja anime names several powerful techniques after the Shinto creator pair and the three noble children of Izanagi and Izanami.

productions.title: Troy
productions.summary: A Bronze-age war epic based on the Iliad, dramatizing the siege through its kings, warriors, and divine prophecies.

productions.title: Apocalypto
productions.summary: Mel Gibson's survival thriller set in the late Maya period, saturated with Mesoamerican temple ritual and solar imagery.

productions.title: Kung Fu Panda
productions.summary: A wuxia comedy about a panda chosen as the Dragon Warrior, weaving Chinese martial-arts tropes with mythic dragon symbolism.

productions.title: Clash of the Titans
productions.summary: A remake in which Perseus battles the Kraken and the underworld while Olympus argues over the fate of mortals.

productions.title: Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief
productions.summary: A modern demigod discovers he is Poseidon's son and is drawn into a conflict among the Olympian gods.

productions.title: Thor
productions.summary: The Marvel Cinematic Universe introduces the Norse thunder god and his exile to Earth after defying Odin.

productions.title: Immortals
productions.summary: A stylized Greek-myth action film pitting Theseus and the gods against the ruthless Titan-aligned king Hyperion.

productions.title: Thor: The Dark World
productions.summary: Thor and Loki reluctantly team up to stop the Dark Elf Malekith from plunging the Nine Realms into darkness.

productions.title: Vikings
productions.summary: A historical drama centered on Ragnar Lothbrok and his sons, with frequent visions of Odin, Valhalla, and Ragnarok.

productions.title: Smite
productions.summary: A third-person MOBA that pits gods and mythological figures from multiple pantheons against one another.

productions.title: Fate/Grand Order
productions.summary: A mobile gacha RPG that summons heroic and divine spirits from world history and mythology as Servants.

productions.title: Gods of Egypt
productions.summary: A fantasy action film depicting the conflict between Horus and Set for the throne of Egypt, with Ra's solar barge at stake.

productions.title: Thor: Ragnarok
productions.summary: A comedic cosmic adventure that brings Ragnarok, Surtur, Hela, and the destruction of Asgard into the MCU.

productions.title: Wonder Woman
productions.summary: Diana of Themyscira enters the Great War, drawing on Amazonian and Olympian backstory tied to Zeus and Ares.

productions.title: American Gods
productions.summary: Neil Gaiman's adaptation brings old gods to modern America, prominently featuring Odin, Anubis, and the Slavic black god.

productions.title: The Lighthouse
productions.summary: A psychological horror film soaked in maritime myth, with Prometheus imagery of fire, punishment, and defiance of the gods.

productions.title: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
productions.summary: A Japanese action game set in the Sengoku period, drawing on Buddhist wrathful deities, immortality quests, and Shinto dragon imagery.

productions.title: Mulan
productions.summary: A live-action retelling of the Chinese legend, with phoenix symbolism and ancestor-veneration themes.

productions.title: Hades
productions.summary: A roguelike action game in which Zagreus attempts to escape the Underworld, encountering most of the Olympian pantheon.

productions.title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
productions.summary: The remake reintroduces the series' signature summon materia, including Shiva, Ifrit, and Leviathan.

productions.title: Ghost of Tsushima
productions.summary: An open-world samurai game set during the Mongol invasion, dotted with Shinto shrines, foxes, and kami of wind and thunder.

productions.title: Record of Ragnarok
productions.summary: A tournament anime pits humanity's greatest fighters against gods from many pantheons to decide mankind's survival.

productions.title: Moon Knight
productions.summary: The Marvel series centers on an avatar of Khonshu navigating Egyptian gods and the afterlife in modern London and Cairo.

productions.title: The Northman
productions.summary: A Norse revenge saga directed by Robert Eggers, steeped in Odinic prophecy, Valhalla, and Viking ritual.

productions.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
productions.summary: The sequel introduces Talokan, a Mesoamerican-inspired underwater civilization whose visual language draws on Aztec and Maya deities.

productions.title: God of War Ragnarök
productions.summary: Kratos and Atreus journey through the Nine Realms during Fimbulwinter, confronting figures from Norse apocalyptic myth.

productions.title: Sandman
productions.summary: Neil Gaiman's adaptation of the Endless includes encounters with gods from Greek, Egyptian, and Norse traditions.

productions.title: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
productions.summary: A faithful Disney+ adaptation of Riordan's novels, following Percy through Camp Half-Blood and encounters with the Greek gods.
